# stratmeyeranalytica.org — Machine-Readable Manifest

> Stratmeyer Analytica is an independent consulting and auditing practice operated by Adam Ian Stratmeyer, J.D.
> Core specializations: AI Development, Personal Consulting, IRB Protocol Review, and Empirical AI Ethics.
> Personal website of the Director: https://adamstratmeyer.com
> Direct Contact: adamstratmeyer@gmail.com | inquiries@stratmeyeranalytica.org

## Core Practice Pillars
- [AI Development](/practice/ai-development.html) — Autonomous agent workflows, private local inference clusters, and deterministic evaluation test harnesses.
- [Personal Consulting](/practice/personal-consulting.html) — Confidential 1-on-1 strategic advisory and dispute counsel with Director Adam Ian Stratmeyer, J.D.
- [IRB Review](/practice/irb-review.html) — Institutional Review Board human-subjects protocol auditing, 45 CFR 46 (Common Rule), and Belmont Report ethics.
- [AI Ethics & Algorithmic Auditing](/practice/ai-ethics.html) — Empirical measurement of automated system behavior, observable function metrics, and bias stress-testing.
